**Credit costs:** 5 standard (1 credit) - the exact cost is in each endpoint heading below.

## GET /v1/apple_music/album - 1 credit (standard)

Returns album metadata: title, artist, artwork, track count, and the Apple Music album URL. Pass either `id` or `url`.

**Use when** you want it for a whole record; when you care about one song only, track gives that song's own detail.
**Cost** cache 600 s
**Paging** none

**Query params**

- `id` (optional, string) - Apple Music album ID.
- `url` (optional, string) - Apple Music album URL. · e.g. `https://music.apple.com/us/album/red-taylors-version/1590368448`

**Constraints**

- Provide at least one of `id`, `url`.

**Response** `Post` object at `data`, `{ computed, post }` ([full schema](schemas/Post.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `post.content.text` | Post caption, description, or text content |
| `post.id` | Platform-specific post ID… |
| `post.url` | Direct URL to the post on the source platform |
| `post.author.username` | Author username |
| `computed.content_category` | Keyword-classified content category… |
| `computed.engagement_rate` | Computed engagement rate (0..1). |

+10 more fields in the full schema. Never filled: `post.author.avatar_url`, `post.author.verified`, `post.content.duration_seconds`, `post.engagement.comments`, `post.engagement.likes`, `post.engagement.saves`, `post.engagement.shares`, `post.engagement.views`, `post.flags.nsfw`, `post.flags.pinned`, `post.flags.spoiler`, `post.published_at`.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/apple_music/album" \
  --data-urlencode "url=https://music.apple.com/us/album/red-taylors-version/1590368448" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/apple_music/artist - 1 credit (standard)

Returns artist metadata: id, name, artwork, and the Apple Music artist URL. Pass either `id` or `url`.

**Use when** you have an artist id or URL and want the artist itself rather than one of their tracks or albums.
**Cost** cache 900 s
**Paging** none

**Query params**

- `id` (optional, string) - Apple Music artist ID.
- `url` (optional, string) - Apple Music artist URL. · e.g. `https://music.apple.com/us/artist/taylor-swift/159260351`

**Constraints**

- Provide at least one of `id`, `url`.

**Response** `Author` object at `data`, `{ author, computed }` ([full schema](schemas/Author.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `author.id` | Platform-specific user ID… |
| `author.url` | Direct URL to the profile page |
| `author.username` | User handle or username |
| `author.avatar_url` | URL to profile picture |
| `author.display_name` | Display name or full name |
| `computed.content_category` | Keyword-classified content category… |

+3 more fields in the full schema. Never filled: `author.bio`, `author.followers`, `author.following`, `author.likes_count`, `author.posts_count`, `author.verified`.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/apple_music/artist" \
  --data-urlencode "url=https://music.apple.com/us/artist/taylor-swift/159260351" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/apple_music/charts - 1 credit (standard)

Returns what a country is playing most on Apple Music right now: the Top Songs, Top Albums, Top Music Videos or Top Playlists chart, with no keyword in. Each item is a Post: `content.text` is the title, `author.username` the artist, `url` the Apple Music link and `content.thumbnail_url` the artwork. The chart position is on `ext.trend`: `rank` (1 is the top), `country_code`, `chart` and Apple's own `chart_title` and `updated_at`. `ext.apple_music` carries `kind`, `release_date`, `artist_id`, `artist_url`, `genres` and `content_advisory`. `published_at` is the release date at midnight UTC. Playlists have no artist or release date, so those are null. The item ids work with /v1/apple_music/track and /v1/apple_music/album for the full record. A country Apple Music does not publish a chart for is a free 400. Exact repeats within an hour are served from cache at 0 credits.

**Use when** you want to see what a market is playing right now without naming a track, or to track chart positions country by country over time.
**Cost** cache 3600 s
**Paging** single page - One ranked chart per country and type with no second page. The chart is at most 100 deep; `limit` sets how many positions ship.

**Query params**

- `country` (optional, string) - Country as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, in any case (`us`, `DE`, `kr`). Apple Music publishes a chart for most countries where it is sold; one it does not is rejected with a free 400. `uk` is read as `gb`. Defaults to `us`. · e.g. `de`
- `type` (optional, enum: songs | albums | music-videos | playlists) - Which chart: `songs` (the default), `albums`, `music-videos` or `playlists`. · e.g. `songs`
- `limit` (optional, integer, 1-100) - How many chart positions to return, from the top, 1 to 100. Defaults to 50. · e.g. `10`

**Response** `PostList` rows at `data.items[]`, each `{ computed, post }` ([full schema](schemas/PostList.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `post.content.text` | Post caption, description, or text content |
| `post.id` | Platform-specific post ID… |
| `post.published_at` | Post creation timestamp as an ISO 8601 UTC string. |
| `post.url` | Direct URL to the post on the source platform |
| `post.author.username` | Author username |
| `computed.content_category` | Keyword-classified content category… |

+17 more fields in the full schema. Never filled: `post.author.avatar_url`, `post.author.verified`, `post.content.duration_seconds`, `post.content.media_urls`, `post.engagement.comments`, `post.engagement.likes`, `post.engagement.saves`, `post.engagement.shares`, `post.engagement.views`, `post.flags.nsfw`, `post.flags.pinned`, `post.flags.spoiler`. Page-level: `data.dropped`.

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/apple_music/charts" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/apple_music/search - 1 credit (standard)

Returns Apple Music search results for a query. Pass `type` to restrict the result kind (for example song, album, or artist).

**Use when** you want to find a catalog item by keyword, then call artist, album, or track with an id or URL for the full record.
**Cost** cache 120 s
**Paging** single page - Fixed-window feed: upstream returns a single non-cursored result set.

**Query params**

- `query` (required) - Search query. · e.g. `taylor swift`
- `type` (optional, string) - Optional result kind such as song, album, or artist. · e.g. `song`

**Response** `SearchResult` rows at `data.items[]` (inferred from a sample): `album`, `artist_name`, `artwork.bgColor`, `artwork.height`, `artwork.textColor1`, `artwork.textColor2`, `artwork.textColor3`, `artwork.textColor4` (+13 more).

Page-level: `data.dropped`.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/apple_music/search" \
  --data-urlencode "query=taylor swift" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/apple_music/track - 1 credit (standard)

Returns track metadata: title, artist, duration, preview audio URL, and the Apple Music track URL. Pass either `id` or `url`.

**Use when** you want it for a single song; album returns the record it sits on and artist returns the performer.
**Cost** cache 600 s
**Paging** none

**Query params**

- `id` (optional, string) - Apple Music track ID.
- `url` (optional, string) - Apple Music track URL. · e.g. `https://music.apple.com/us/album/22-taylors-version/1590368448?i=1590368457`

**Constraints**

- Provide at least one of `id`, `url`.

**Response** `Post` object at `data`, `{ computed, post }` ([full schema](schemas/Post.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `post.content.text` | Post caption, description, or text content |
| `post.id` | Platform-specific post ID… |
| `post.url` | Direct URL to the post on the source platform |
| `post.author.username` | Author username |
| `computed.content_category` | Keyword-classified content category… |
| `computed.engagement_rate` | Computed engagement rate (0..1). |

+10 more fields in the full schema. Never filled: `post.author.avatar_url`, `post.author.verified`, `post.engagement.comments`, `post.engagement.likes`, `post.engagement.saves`, `post.engagement.shares`, `post.engagement.views`, `post.flags.nsfw`, `post.flags.pinned`, `post.flags.spoiler`, `post.published_at`.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/apple_music/track" \
  --data-urlencode "url=https://music.apple.com/us/album/22-taylors-version/1590368448?i=1590368457" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```
